subject: design/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: Add a neutral, typed host port owned by internal/draft; keep the existing lifecycle, compiler, readiness, Git operations, and approval selector as the common core. Register GitHub and Forgejo adapters by provider without growing the task codehost port. The same Host exposes the read-only repository-policy query that supplies abandonment's affirmative auto-delete precondition.
